    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AirplaneSquare
    Represents an Airplane/Travel square.
    Board
    Represents the game board.
    Card
    Abstract base class representing a generic card in the game.
    CardManager
    Manages the deck of cards in the game.
    CardSquare
    Represents a Card square (Chance/Community Chest).
    CharacterSelectScreen
    Represents the screen where players choose their avatars.
    Dice
    Represents the dice used in the game.
    GameBoardScreen
    Represents the main game board screen where the gameplay takes place.
    GameController
    The main controller class for the Inverse Monopoly game.
    GameMenu
    Represents the Main Menu screen of the game.
    GoSquare
    Represents the "Go" (Start) square.
    IslandSquare
    Represents an Island square, functioning similarly to a Property.
    JailSquare
    Represents the Jail square.
    LotterySquare
    Represents a Lottery square where players have a chance to win money.
    Main
     
    Main
    The main entry point for the "Inverse Monopoly" (Beggar Game) application.
    MoveToAirPlane
    A card that forces the player to move to the Airplane Square (Airport).
    Player
    Represents a player in the game.
    Property
    Represents a purchasable property square on the board.
    ReceiveMoneyCard
    A card that awards a specific amount of money to the player.
    Rentable
    Interface for squares that can charge rent (e.g., Property, Utilities).
    SkipTurnCard
    A card that penalizes the player by forcing them to skip future turns.
    SoundManager
    Manages the playback of Background Music (BGM) for the application.
    Square
    Abstract base class representing a square on the game board.
    TaxSquare
    Represents a Tax square where players must pay a randomized tax amount.
